about: GTA origin (Delta, pillar 3 GTA history). Gary Penn (DMA Design, worked on the original GTA) to Tristan Donovan, printed by Gamasutra 2011-01-31: the game was almost canned, publisher BMG Interactive wanted to can it, it crashed all the time, the handling was appalling; 'One day, I think it was a bug, the police suddenly became mental and aggressive ... trying to ram me off the road ... That was awesome, so that stayed in.' Race'n'Chase design document dated 22 March 1995 (posted by Mike Dailly, 2011). First release 1997 (Europe, PC; day disputed, year only). GTA VI: Coming November 19, 2026 (rockstargames.com/VI). The bug is always attributed ('One developer thinks'). Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A was almost canceled.

lines.text: The publisher wanted to scrap it.

lines.say: It began in nineteen ninety-five as Race 'n' Chase.

lines.text: But it crashed all the time.
Then one day, the cops went crazy.
They tried to ram you off the road.
One developer thinks it was a bug.
He called it awesome. It stayed in.

lines.say: G T A came out in nineteen ninety-seven.
G T A six lands November nineteenth.
